summary: Trinity County, CA lookout built 1934 per the register, removed spring 1980, nothing remains; a 1952 survey and 1954 newspaper item conflict on dates and tower height.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan BC-301 cabin on a 20-foot H-brace open steel tower (register); a 1952 survey describes a 30-foot steel tower
facts.status_note: Register says the tower was removed in the spring of 1980 and nothing remains at the site
facts.agency: US Forest Service, Shasta-Trinity National Forest

visit.trail_note: About 3 miles and just under 3,000 feet of climbing from a Forest Service road switchback; SummitPost says the trail has not been maintained in quite a while

access.note: Sources describe a hiking route to the summit (SummitPost) but say nothing about access rules or closure

corrections.why: The register gives a 20-foot H-brace tower (about 6.1 m). No source read gives 4.3 m. A 1952 survey gives a 30-foot tower (about 9.1 m); see resolved conflicts

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's coordinates (41.121125, -122.746593) are used. The second figure in the record (41.13292, -122.76919) comes from another database that we did not read, and no page we read supports it.

The register gives 1934. A 1952 Coast and Geodetic Survey description and a June 1954 Dunsmuir News item, both quoted on a hobby site, point to a lookout standing or going up in 1952-1954. The sources are not reconciled; the story gives all three.
The register gives a 20-foot tower; the 1952 survey gives 30 feet. Facts use the register figure; the story reports both.
One SummitPost page says the peak has a maintained trail to its summit; another SummitPost page says the trail has not been maintained in quite a while. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: The register is firm on the 1980 removal and on nothing remaining, but the build date and tower height conflict with the 1952 and 1954 items. Those two items were read only as quoted on the hobby site; originals were not checked. The register's photo caption 'Billy's Peak Lookout - 1953' has no image URL in what we read, so no photo was added. Peakbagging lists 'Billys Peak (LO site)', which agrees with removal.
